text: 我是香港大学的助理教授，负责主持机器增强认知实验室。

segments.action: I ride an escalator going upward behind a commuter carrying a white bag and wearing a decorated backpack.
segments.action_brief: I ride the escalator.
segments.environment: Physical space: Indoor/semi-outdoor transit station escalator shaft rising to an elevated railway station concourse. The shaft has light blue concrete walls, an overhead ceiling with lighting fixtures, and a bright daylight opening at the top. On the left wall is a yellow-painted vertical maintenance ladder. A female commuter stands ahead on the escalator wearing a blue-and-white pinXXX short-sleeve shirt dress, white low-top sneakers, grey socks, and a beige structured ita-bag backpack with anime badges displayed under clear vinyl. Objects: Moving grooved metal escalator steps with yellow border lines; brushed stainless steel balustrades on both sides with black rubber moving handrails; recessed fluorescent skirt lighting running along the base of the inner side panels; white safety sticker on the right inner balustrade depicting a prohibited climbing pictogram with text '請勿攀爬 / No climbing'; safety sticker on the left balustrade. Screens: None XXX. Text in world: '請勿攀爬', 'No climbing' on the balustrade warning label. Media: None. Ambient audio: Continuous mechanical hum and metallic vibration of the operating escalator.

A raised planter bed with green foliage runs along the left outdoor railing. Ahead, several commuters walk across the concourse hall. Along the far concourse wall to the right stand automated ticket vending machines and an information board. Commuters walk across the open area.

An overhead black sign displays '2 往月台 / To Platforms' with a train pictogram.
